svg.title: Card fraud platform: system diagram, Layers 1 and 2
svg.desc: Deployable units of Layer 1 and Layer 2 and the data between them, numbered per flow.
svg.text: CARD FRAUD PLATFORM · SYSTEM DIAGRAM · LAYERS 1 AND 2
System diagram, Layers 1 and 2: deployable units and the data they exchange. Layer 3, the agents, has its own diagram.
four buckets; the lakehouse bucket holds one folder per zone, as Delta tables
serves the fraud model; its logger copies
end user: every card authorization, real time
daily, Airflow: DP1, DP2, DP3, then the materialize pipeline
on drift or by hand: pipeline run; Jenkins builds the model image
live Drift API + daily data drift pipeline
Numbers give the order inside each flow: S1 to S6 follow one payment from the authorization switch and back.
Arrow = data moving from A to B, labelled with the data; a call without data (B2, M7) points from caller to callee.
White box = one container or pod. Tag top left = where it runs: compose profile, namespace (ns) or host.
Dashed boxes: support services used by many units (arrows left out).
Feast is a library, not a unit: it runs inside the Scoring API, the push jobs, Airflow, Jupyter and the training pipeline's pods.
Layer 3 (agents, gateway, tool servers) is on its own diagram; its tool servers read the Feast online store and call the Fraud Scoring API (A11, A14).
